build_densepose_predictor: build a DensePose predictor instance from a Detectron2 config node and input channel count
build_densepose_data_filter: build a DensePose data filter to select training data from feature tensors and proposals
build_densepose_head: build a DensePose ROI head from a Detectron2 config node and input channel count
build_densepose_losses: build a DensePose loss module from a Detectron2 config node for training
build_densepose_embedder: build a CSE embedder module to embed mesh vertices into an embedding space
